scope: Deterministic isolated workflow acceptance, no model calls or live acquisition
failures: Long summaries must expose all errors through a complete artifact; missing artifacts fail
No-change wait must not request rereads or replacement workers; provider outages remain immediate
Employer affinity preserves exact keys, bounded capacity, deterministic ties and singleton publishers/ambiguity
Old assignments resume unchanged; empty and oversized employer groups remain valid
Reused pages retain original captures and per-posting actual queries; foreign, stale or unbound evidence fails
Independent quote, gaps, enum and keyword errors appear on the first rejected payload
Work authorization errors appear alongside report errors, and one repair passes without consuming another rejected attempt
Bad parent types stop dependent checks without masking unrelated errors
Identical rejected payloads do not consume another attempt; budget exhaustion requires the observed ledger
Candidate/rule drift, foreign ownership, old part tampering and final/part mismatch remain rejected
Frozen model, effort, research, report threshold and retry policy are unchanged
Reordered valid results reach canonical isolated commit with the same posting-key business content
